baseObservation.meaning: immutable post-PR208 main preimage; Git/GitHub owns live facts

trajectory.reason: user-directed bounded post-UIUX defect reconciliation over 656 screenshot-derived findings; preserves UIUX-CONVERGE-0 terminal history and leaves C2→C1→C3→C4 critical path unchanged

absorptionRule: Every F-0001..F-0656 must map to exactly one primary mechanism; a mechanism may cover multiple root causes while the original root cause remains preserved. Unclassified or duplicate-primary findings fail closed.

mechanisms.name: Shell focus and chrome contraction
mechanisms.property: Primary shell contains navigation and context with secondary utilities moved behind profile/progressive controls; accepted onboarding is not a permanent primary navigation peer.

mechanisms.name: Business-first action and state grammar
mechanisms.property: First-plane titles, statuses and CTAs describe the business job, next decision or outcome before product/technical implementation language.

mechanisms.name: Comparable record density
mechanisms.property: Repeated business records use compact comparable rows, bounded facts and one visible record-local next action; secondary actions and metadata are progressive.

mechanisms.name: Progressive context after work
mechanisms.property: Method, standards, basis, proof and claim-boundary context remain reachable through compact closed progressive controls; canonical DOM precedence may remain for compatibility, but expanded narratives cannot interrupt or visually dominate the operational work plane.

mechanisms.name: Responsive semantic contraction
mechanisms.property: Narrow viewports reduce simultaneous semantic layers and action fan-out rather than stacking the desktop representation; horizontal overflow is forbidden.

mechanisms.name: Registry triage and bounded initial universe
mechanisms.property: Large registries expose a bounded initial work set with state/search triage and explicit reveal of remaining records; catalog explanation is separated from record operation.

mechanisms.name: Scenario-first onboarding
mechanisms.property: Onboarding starts from role/job/scenario, advances one step at a time, requires a concrete action and explains architecture only after the user has experienced the corresponding business concept.

mechanisms.name: Evidence action collapse
mechanisms.property: Evidence/dossier/export is a secondary cluster or record-level overflow; format choice never competes with the business next action.

mechanisms.name: Admin task-first console
mechanisms.property: Admin surfaces lead with blockers, impact and next corrective action; provider/identity implementation detail is progressive and boundary-scoped.

mechanisms.name: Legibility and inline critical semantics
mechanisms.property: Critical authority, limitation and next-action meaning is visible without hover; microcopy remains readable and tooltips add only marginal detail.

globalDoD: G01 656/656 findings have one primary mechanism and zero unmapped/duplicate-primary records.
G02 22/22 witness surfaces are covered by at least one mechanism and retain their local owner.
G03 no new UI composition root, decision-presentation owner, business writer, store, SOT or registry is introduced.
G04 first-plane language is business/job/decision oriented; product, method and technical exposition is secondary.
G05 critical authority/claim-boundary meaning is visible without hover-only dependency.
G06 mobile/narrow layouts contract semantic layers and forbid page horizontal overflow.
G07 evidence/export remains reachable but cannot outrank the business next action.
G08 onboarding is scenario-first, progressive and action-grounded rather than manifesto-first.
G09 large registries are bounded/triaged before expansion and repeated records are comparable.
G10 representative-human usability, legal compliance and deployment effectiveness remain external evidence.
intermediateDoD: I01 shell: accepted onboarding leaves primary navigation; replay remains available from profile utilities.
I02 shell: mobile header utilities collapse to icon/short labels and service navigation stays one horizontal rail without page overflow.
I03 home: title/purpose names the work and priority rows state why intervention is required.
I04 process catalogue: seven processes remain one-row comparable records with code secondary and job/CTA business-first.
I05 procedures: method/context remains compact and closed by default so it cannot visually dominate operational records.
I06 repeated records: one visible next action plus bounded facts; overflow contains secondary/evidence actions.
I07 MC-01: standard catalogue and requirement/mapping work do not render as an unbounded simultaneous first plane.
I08 proof/epistemic: begin with a business reconstruction question; technical taxonomy is progressive.
I09 admin: blockers and corrective next actions precede configuration implementation detail.
I10 accessibility: controls keep accessible names, touch targets and focusability after visual contraction.
localDoD: L01 source checker verifies all mechanism owner files and absorption markers.
L02 contract checker verifies F-0001..F-0656 exact coverage and source-audit digest.
L03 saturation exercises at least 10,000,000 multi-abstraction evaluator calls with discovery+holdout and zero survivors.
L04 saturation covers all 10 mechanisms, 12 root causes, pairwise mechanism combinations and cross-layer combinations.
L05 compression oracle rejects merging any mechanism pair when it erases a distinct root-cause/property witness.
L06 nearest UI checks and syntax checks pass on the exact candidate tree.
L07 ten local qualification cycles pass on the exact final byte-candidate before PR materialization.
L08 GitHub materialization is byte-compared with the locally qualified candidate for every changed file.
L09 exact-head CI has zero failure and zero pending before repository DoD is claimed.
L10 skipped/conditional jobs are listed explicitly and cannot be represented as success.
checklist: Does the first screen tell the user what work requires attention now?
Is every visible primary CTA phrased as a business action/outcome?
Can comparable records be scanned without reading mini-essays?
Is method/context compact, closed and subordinate to operational work by default?
Can the user understand authority/limitations without hover?
Does mobile remove or defer detail instead of merely stacking it?
Is every registry bounded before the full universe is expanded?
Does onboarding start with a concrete role/scenario/action?
Are evidence/export controls secondary to operational decisions?
Does Admin say what needs fixing before how the system is configured?
Are status labels decision-semantic rather than merely storage/state jargon?
Are product codes/technical names secondary when not needed to choose the job?
Are microcopy and touch targets legible?
Is each repeated record limited to one visible primary action?
Does each critical boundary sit next to the metric/state it constrains?
Do local owners, not a global rewriter, own local business copy/order?
Are read-only/auditor modes still truthful after contraction?
Does every mechanism have a nearest falsifier?
Does the UI avoid implying legal applicability, compliance, effectiveness or external assurance?
claimBoundary: This contract proves repository-bounded absorption/classification and executable UI composition properties only. It does not prove representative-human usability, beauty, legal/compliance correctness, organizational effectiveness, deployment effectiveness, E3-HUMAN, E3-GOV, E4-DEPLOY, Enterprise Candidate or Enterprise Ready.
